Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?

Whether health insurance can be used depends on the type of injury and your situation. Our staff can explain the details when you visit or contact the clinic. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
We are located at one two three Sample-cho, Urawa-ku, Saitama City, Saitama. You can also check our website for a map and directions. Would you like to know anything else?
Can I walk from Urawa Station?
I'm sorry, I don't have that information right now. I can pass your details to our staff so they can get back to you. May I have your name, please?
Is it OK to come by car?
Yes, you can come by car as parking is available near the clinic. Would you like assistance with anything else?
It's my first time. Is there anything I should bring?

If applicable, please bring your My Number health insurance card or your eligibility certificate. It’s also helpful to have any information about previous treatments or injuries related to your current concern. Is there anything else you would like to ask?
